title: Houthis and Saudis Trade Claims of Military Attacks as Conflict Escalates
summary: The Houthis, an Iran-backed militia in Yemen, said they had downed a Saudi jet, while Saudi authorities accused the group of firing a drone near Mecca. The Houthis denied doing so.
